clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Arcane Feedback sends human priests back to Stormwind. Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon reluctantly honors the Alliance summons. There, High Priestess Laurena prepares the acolyte for deeper instruction.

Priestess Alathea oversees visiting priests in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes the formal alliance between the kaldorei and Stormwind, yet distrusts human magical and spiritual practices. Night elves see arcane power as volatile and dangerous, a view shaped by ten millennia of grief since the War of the Ancients. Even human divine rites trouble the night elf clergy when they blur radiant faith with arcane workings.

Alathea honors the bond between the Alliance races and sends you to answer a recall from the Cathedral of Light. High Priestess Laurena has sent couriers across the seas to gather human priests for advanced training. In Stormwind, you leave Elune's moonlit groves behind for the grand stone sanctuaries and golden radiance of the Holy Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is time for you to return to Stormwind, young one. Your superiors there have called you back for more training. And although it disturbs me some, your race and mine are allies and I would not betray that.
I do not mean to be so coy with you--my distrust of arcane magics, be they divine inspired or not, is still strong within me.
You will know of what I speak after you return to your Cathedral of Light. Speak to High Priestess Laurena when you arrive.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have wonderful timing, friend. I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people.
Are you ready? Ready for more training I mean. You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.
